title: Insights into the recruitment of the H3K4me3 reader Spp1 by the meiotic double-strand break protein Mer2.
authors: Liloku, Pascaline; Melo, David Alvarez; Gisbert, Victor G; Mannaert, Sarah; Mechleb, Karen; Derclaye, Sylvie; Ray, Ankita; Alsteens, David; Volkov, Alexander N; Sterckx, Yann G-J; Claeys Bouuaert, Corentin
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold建模与生化重构研究减数分裂DSB蛋白Mer2与H3K4me3阅读器Spp1及其DNA复合物的组装机制，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，但非典型TF-DNA结合。
abstract: The formation of DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) by Spo11 is tied to the loop-axis organization of meiotic chromosomes. Before DSB formation, chromatin loops marked by histone H3K4 trimethylation become tethered to the chromosome axis through interactions between Spp1 and Mer2. Mer2 is an essential partner of Spo11 thought to assemble the DSB machinery via biomolecular condensation, but these molecular assemblies remain poorly characterized. Here, using AlphaFold modeling, biochemical reconstitution, and biophysical validation, we explored the relationship between Mer2, Spp1, and their DNA-bound complexes. The tetrameric coiled-coil domain of Mer2 has four rotationally symmetrical sites that can bind a C-terminal alpha-helix of Spp1. However, Mer2-Spp1 complexes assemble with a 4x2 stoichiometry, perhaps through allosteric modulation or steric hindrance. Mer2 also accommodates multiple DNA duplexes, allowing the assembly of tripartite Mer2-Spp1-DNA complexes with branched DNA substrates and effective recruitment of Spp1 within nucleoprotein condensates. However, because the Spp1- and DNA-binding sites of Mer2 partially overlap, Spp1 recruitment reduces DNA binding by Mer2, which is compensated by positively charged residues within Spp1. Nevertheless, this DNA-binding motif appears to be dispensable for the meiotic function of Spp1. These findings provide insights into the structural organization of Mer2 and Spp1 and their role in the assembly of the meiotic DSB machinery.
abstract_zh: Spo11 引发的 DNA 双链断裂（DSBs）形成与减数分裂染色体的环-轴组织相关联。在 DSB 形成之前，由组蛋白 H3K4 三甲基化标记的染色质环通过 Spp1 与 Mer2 之间的相互作用被锚定至染色体轴。Mer2 是 Spo11 的关键伙伴，被认为通过生物分子凝聚 (biomolecular condensation) 组装 DSB 机制，但这些分子组装体的特征仍知之甚少。在此，我们利用 AlphaFold 建模、生化重构和生物物理验证，探讨了 Mer2、Spp1 及其与 DNA 结合复合物之间的关系。Mer2 的四聚卷曲螺旋结构域具有四个旋转对称位点，可结合 Spp1 的 C 端 α-螺旋。然而，Mer2-Spp1 复合物以 4x2 的化学计量比组装，可能通过变构调节或空间位阻实现。Mer2 还能容纳多个 DNA 双链，从而允许形成具有分支 DNA 底物的三方 Mer2-Spp1-DNA 复合物，并在核蛋白凝聚体中有效招募 Spp1。然而，由于 Mer2 的 Spp1 和 DNA 结合位点部分重叠，Spp1 的招募会减少 Mer2 的 DNA 结合，这一效应由 Spp1 内的正电荷残基所补偿。尽管如此，该 DNA 结合基序似乎对 Spp1 的减数分裂功能并非必需。这些发现为 Mer2 和 Spp1 的结构组织及其在减数分裂 DSB 机制组装中的作用提供了见解。
